verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Though I walk through the midst of my trouble
You will fill Your purpose in me
I lift my head from the dirt and see those eyes
I feel a peace in the wind to my surprise

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are sovereign, Lord, and I bless You
You are perfect in nature

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
In the valleys and the shadows
You have set a table for me
Though it’s hard to see I will follow
I give it to You, I give it to You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You won’t let me go
You won’t let me go

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
You declare the end from the beginning
You alone are God
